C1235.title: ShipuShi Fined RMB 1.1686 Million for 'Either-Or' Monopolistic Conduct
C1235.summary: The Shanghai Municipal Market Regulation Bureau imposed an administrative penalty on Shanghai ShipuShi Commerce and Trade Development Co., Ltd. for implementing an 'either-or' monopolistic practice in the internet food delivery platform service market, fining it 3% of its 2018 sales, totaling RMB 1.1686 million. The case represents a direct local antitrust enforcement action against platform exclusive-dealing conduct.
